tools.name: fetch_html
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return raw HTML. Response is the upstream MCP envelope {content:[{type:'text',text:'<html>'}], isError:false}.

tools.name: fetch_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return its content converted to Markdown via turndown. Response shape: {content:[{type:'text',text:'<md>'}], isError:false}.

tools.name: fetch_txt
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return cleaned plain text (scripts/styles stripped, whitespace normalized). Shape: {content:[{type:'text',text:'<plain>'}], isError:false}.

tools.name: fetch_json
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return its body parsed as JSON (then JSON-stringified inside the text content). Shape: {content:[{type:'text',text:'<json-str>'}], isError:false}.
